description.value: Knight Street Cafe is a well-loved homestyle breakfast and lunch spot in East Vancouver that has been serving the community since 2016. The all-day menu leans heavily on fresh, locally sourced ingredients — from hearty corned beef hash and eggs Benedict to tofu scrambles and veggie burritos — making it a satisfying fuel stop for cyclists of varied tastes. Dine-in and takeout are both available, and Uber Eats delivery is offered for riders who prefer to eat on the move.
